name: Bento Grid
what_it_means: Named after the Japanese lunch box, Bento layouts arrange features into a tidy grid of rounded tiles of different sizes. Each tile tells one small story (a stat, a feature, a visual), so a whole product can be scanned at a glance. Popularised by Apple keynotes and modern SaaS sites.
signature_moves: Rounded tiles of mixed sizes on one grid
One idea per tile: stat, icon, screenshot
Often dark mode with one accent per tile
Great for feature overviews and dashboards
best_for: SaaS feature sections, product launches, portfolios, dashboards
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Create a features section for [PRODUCT] using a Bento Grid layout. Dark background (#0B0B0F), tiles in #17171D with 24px radius, 16px gaps, on a 4-column grid with mixed spans (one 2x2 hero tile, two 2x1 tiles, three 1x1 tiles). Each tile holds exactly one idea: a big stat, a feature with an icon, a mini chart, or a UI screenshot. Use Inter/Geist, white headings, grey (#9A9AA5) body. Give each tile a subtle accent glow (violet #7C5CFF or mint #3DDC97). Hover: tile lifts 4px and the border brightens. Make it responsive: tiles stack to 1 column on mobile.
